judging_rules.purpose: Expected-results manifest for the 167 cases in results_report.json. Keep it separate from code under test.
pass_requires: HTTP 2xx, no timeout, no ERROR status
expected_clean cases must have zero error-level findings and zero vulnerabilities; style warnings (unused variable, shadowing) are allowed

definitions.clean: zero errors and zero vulnerabilities; warnings allowed
definitions.validated_fix: a candidate with status VALIDATED, original finding resolved (matched by rule plus normalized snippet, not by line number), no new findings, and the compiler accepts it
definitions.alternatives_or_unresolved: PASS if the system returns UNRESOLVED or presents several alternatives; FAIL if it presents a single VALIDATED patch that silently picks one fix
definitions.report_only: finding reported correctly; no automatic code change required
definitions.unresolved_ok: the right answer is no automatic fix
definitions.validated_or_partial: any VALIDATED candidate must be correct; status must say what remains
definitions.line_tolerance: GCC reports a missing delimiter at the next token, so allow +/-1 line unless the entry says 0
definitions.owner_review: ground truth cannot be derived from the zip; mark UNJUDGED until the owner decides

basis_values.project_expected_json: taken from expected.json files in the zip
basis_values.project_results_md: taken from RESULTS.md files in the zip
basis_values.gcc_oracle: independent check with GCC 13 -fsyntax-only (C) or ast.parse (Python); no code was executed
basis_values.owner_review: needs the project owner to decide
